1.4.10 / 2.5.5: the sequence's file picker and the path preview's address fit 320 px
  ok    the sequence's file picker is as wide as its box at most, and 44px tall
  ok    the path preview's address keeps a 14rem basis, so its button wraps below it instead of squeezing it to 31px
  ok    the When choices' fieldset can shrink to a 320px screen

2.4.13: a date and time field keeps its focus bands while the focus is inside it
  ok    date and time fields show the bands on :focus-within, which still matches while the calendar button has the focus

1.3.1 / 2.4.10: each card's title is a heading
  ok    "First, how your emails are signed" is an h2
  ok    "Not set up yet" is an h2
  ok    "This month" is an h2
  ok    "How your emails are signed" is an h2
  ok    "Your list" is an h2
  ok    "Part of Pro" is an h2

2.3.3: opening a draft or writing an email again scrolls without motion when motion is reduced
  ok    no smooth scroll that ignores prefers-reduced-motion
  ok    the scroll reads prefers-reduced-motion

3.3.6: removing a sequence asks first, as deleting a draft does
  ok    the removal asks before it calls the server

2.4.3 / 3.2.1: focus follows what the creator opened and comes back when it closes
  ok    opening a saved email moves focus to its subject
  ok    opening a sequence moves focus to its name
  ok    closing a sequence returns focus to its opener
  ok    the subject field is the one with that id
  ok    the sequence's name field carries the id that is focused
  ok    New sequence and Edit carry the ids focus goes back to
  ok    2.3.3: the subject's focus keeps the reduced-motion scroll to the composer instead of jumping

2.2.5: a session that ends while writing loses nothing after logging in again
  ok    the message says the email stays on the page and to log in again in a new tab
  ok    beside it, a link to log in that opens a new tab and says so
